page.overview:
Who is Adult Education Annex owner?

Adult Education Annex owner is the individual in charge of the Adult Education Annex. He is initially reluctant to let Homer Simpson teach a class in his facility, but upon learning that he was married, he decided Homer could teach a class about maintaining a happy marriage.
